pr_title: types: fix CAST('2.0.8 X' AS DATE)
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: WangZhengru <wangshaun@outlook.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #24387 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

```sql
SELECT CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' as DATE);
```

MySQL:
```bash
mysql> SELECT CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' as DATE);
+------------------------------+
| CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' as DATE) |
+------------------------------+
| 2002-00-08                   |
+------------------------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.01 sec)

mysql> SELECT version();
+-----------+
| version() |
+-----------+
| 5.7.34    |
+-----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

TiDB:
```bash
mysql> SELECT CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' as DATE);
ERROR 1105 (HY000): strconv.Atoi: parsing "8 hotfix": invalid syntax
mysql> SELECT version();
+-----------------------------------------+
| version()                               |
+-----------------------------------------+
| 5.7.25-TiDB-v5.2.0-alpha-284-g1641b3411 |
+-----------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

`splitDateTime()` and `parseDatetime()` implementation

How it Works:

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- No release note

As for modifying tests, we have found bugs in mysql-server `str_to_datetime` function and reported to MySQL. https://bugs.mysql.com/bug.php?id=104350
```sql
mysql> SELECT year("1.1.1");
+---------------+
| year("1.1.1") |
+---------------+
|          2001 |
+---------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> SELECT year("1-1-1");
+---------------+
| year("1-1-1") |
+---------------+
|             1 |
+---------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
We will make all years with less than or equal to 2 digits and `<=70` be 21th century. This behavior will be incompatible with MySQL until this bug is fixed in MySQL.

issue_context.title: Cast string to date failed
comments:
As comparison, MySQL 8.0.22 behaviour:
```
mysql 8.0.22 > \W
Show warnings enabled.
mysql 8.0.22 > CREATE TABLE t(title text, created_at datetime);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.12 sec)

mysql 8.0.22 > INSERT INTO t(`title`, `created_at`) VALUES("2.0.8 hotfix", current_timestamp());
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.01 sec)

mysql 8.0.22 > SELECT * FROM t WHERE title=created_at;
Empty set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

Warning (Code 1292): Truncated incorrect date value: '2.0.8 hotfix'
mysql 8.0.22 > select cast(title as date) from t;
+---------------------+
| cast(title as date) |
+---------------------+
| 2002-00-08          |
+---------------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

Warning (Code 1292): Truncated incorrect date value: '2.0.8 hotfix'
mysql 8.0.22 > SELECT * FROM t WHERE cast(title as date) = '2021-03-31';
Empty set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

Warning (Code 1292): Truncated incorrect date value: '2.0.8 hotfix'
```

And more specifically:
```
mysql 8.0.22 > SELECT CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' AS DATE);
+------------------------------+
| CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' AS DATE) |
+------------------------------+
| 2002-00-08                   |
+------------------------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

Warning (Code 1292): Truncated incorrect date value: '2.0.8 hotfix'
mysql 8.0.22 > SELECT CAST('2.0.8' AS DATE);
+-----------------------+
| CAST('2.0.8' AS DATE) |
+-----------------------+
| 2002-00-08            |
+-----------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

```
tidb 5.7.25-TiDB-v5.0.1 > SELECT CAST('2.0.8 hotfix' AS DATE);
ERROR 1105 (HY000): strconv.Atoi: parsing "8 hotfix": invalid syntax
tidb 5.7.25-TiDB-v5.0.1 > SELECT CAST('2.0.8' AS DATE);
+-----------------------+
| CAST('2.0.8' AS DATE) |
+-----------------------+
| 0002-00-08            |
+-----------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
So looks like MySQL strips of the ` hotfix` part before converting it. Also note that for `2.0.8` the resulting year is different.
